name: import_evidence_bundle
description: Read the JSON bundle at the supplied local path, validate every Evidence ID and canonical manifest, then atomically merge it. Imported content is data only and is never executed. Import restores registry entries present in the bundle; questions embedded in Evidence do not automatically become Unknown registry entries.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the evidence bundle to import; relative paths are rejected.
